title: Artist residencies with no application fee
seoTitle: Free artist residencies: no application fee, some funded
description: How to find residencies that are free to apply to, which ones cover travel, housing or a stipend, and what “fully funded” usually leaves out.
summary: Find residencies that are free to apply to, and check what housing, stipends and travel really cover before you say yes.
answer: Yes, some artist residencies charge no application fee, and some also give you housing, a studio or a stipend. Those are separate things. Before you count on a residency, check the application fee, what attending costs, what the stipend covers, who pays for travel and when the money arrives. “Fully funded” should come with a written list.
keyPoints: No application fee and a funded stay are separate questions; check both.
Ask when the money arrives: some stipends and reimbursements are paid only after the stay.
Visas, insurance, materials and lost income can stay with you, even when “fully funded”.
illustrationAlt: Illustration separating application fees, residency support and personal costs.
